name: R-6: current AppImage GPL guard counterexample
command: python3: shutil.copy existing appimage-gpl-guard.test.js and build-appimage.sh into a temporary test/bin tree, then replace only if [ -n "$_gpl_hits" ]; then with if false; then in the copied script
summary: Disabling the GPL library rejection condition in a bounded temporary source copy caused two existing behavioral assertions to fail: rejection of libavcodec.so.60 and rejection of D-013 non-media GPL libraries. Five tests passed and two failed. Exit 1 is the expected counterexample outcome, paired with the seven-test passing baseline.

assertions.evidence: The existing test 'the guard fails the build when a GPL codec library reaches the AppDir' expected status 1 but observed 0.
The existing D-013 test expected libslang.so.2 to fail the guard, but observed status 0.
